votes.motion: Approve the Work Session Minutes from February 15, 2022, and February 16, 2022 as well as the Formal Meeting Minutes from May 4, 2021, May 18, 2021 and June 21, 2021.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes from the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-6 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on six grant applications (transportation, water efficiency, and bike share grants) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Ordinance: Rezone at approximately 2333 West North Temple Street).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone to remove the Airport Flight Path Protection Overlay District Influence Zone A at 2333 W North Temple Street and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council Meeting (Ordinance: Street Vacation at 601 South 900 East).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed partial vacation of public right-of-way at 601 South 900 East and defers action to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 15A and 15B of 2022, Amending the Salt Lake City Code Pursuant to Petition No. PLNPCM2021-01033, and Approve a Legislative Intent urging Administration to include in their review process for Parts 2 and 3 of the HRC/Shelter text amendment petition, recommendations to promote geographic equity of HRCs/Shelters by expanding the zoning districts where they are allowed in the City.
votes.description: Adopts ordinances amending zoning code related to Homeless Resource Centers and Homeless Shelters, including removing them as conditional uses from certain zoning districts, and approves a legislative intent to promote geographic equity in siting such facilities.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer the item to a future date for action (One-year Action Plan for Community Development Block Grant & Other Federal Grants for Fiscal Year 2022-23).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY 2022-23 One-Year Annual Action Plan for federal HUD grants (CDBG, HOME, ESG, HOPWA) and refers the item to a future meeting for action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 11 of 2022, Text Amendment for Notice of Work in the Public Right of Way.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance requiring that adjacent property owners be notified of permitted work being performed in the public right-of-way.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 6B of 2022, amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document only for items A-3 (Healthcare Innovation – Biohive, $25,000) and A-8 (Violent Crimes Unit COPS Hiring Grant City Match, budget neutral); items A-7, E-4, and I-2 not adopted.
votes.description: Partially adopts Budget Amendment No. 6 for FY2021-22, approving funding for a healthcare innovation initiative and a police grant match while declining to adopt items related to July fireworks, a Bonneville Shoreline Trail grant, and a parks impact fee re-scope.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 12 of 2022, Special Event Permits of Less than 31 Days, extending the maximum length of a special event permit for park use from 20 to 31 days provided the Mayor approves the event for a reason identified in writing.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance amending City Code to allow special events lasting up to 31 days on City property with written mayoral approval, expanding from the prior 20-day limit.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (including setting public hearing dates for Stealth Towers and Western Gardens rezone, and board appointments for Rich Tuttle, Catherine Tucker, Sarah Johnson, Tyler Schmidt, and Katie Bennett).
votes.description: Approves the full consent agenda, which includes setting future public hearing dates and confirming multiple board and commission appointments.
